latestVersion.changelog:
video-ai-generator-free 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly turns ideas, scripts, or prompts into AI-generated video outlines, scenes, and scripts for free.
- Features automatic setup with free 7-day token, session management, and cloud rendering via distributed GPU backend.
- Supports video/voiceover/caption generation, editing, uploading, and exporting in multiple formats (mp4, mov, webm, etc.).
- Built-in error handling for common issues like expired tokens, no credits, unsupported files, and rate limits.
- Simple commands for checking credits, session state, uploading assets, and managing exports.
- Helps all users — creators, marketers, and educators — build high-quality, structured videos without prior editing experience.
